name: Azel Lipson
source:
The youngest bachelor. He seems to be an innocent, little brother type but takes joy in messing around with Colette because he finds funny to piss her off.

Unlike the other guys who all make attempts to court Colette, Azel’s doesn't care about it. In fact, he says that it would be better for her to choose anyone but him.

He likes teddy bears and his room is full of them. However, he is afraid of rabbits.

[spoiler]He is Claire's older brother.[/spoiler]
